prompt: Name a property on a standard US Monopoly board.

answers.name: Boardwalk
answers.fact: The most expensive square, and named for the one in Atlantic City.

answers.name: Park Place
answers.fact: Its Atlantic City namesake still exists, running down to the beach.

answers.name: Mediterranean Avenue
answers.fact: The cheapest property on the board.

answers.name: Baltic Avenue
answers.fact: Shares the cheapest colour group with Mediterranean.

answers.name: Reading Railroad
answers.fact: Pronounced like redding. A real line running out of Philadelphia.

answers.name: Marvin Gardens
answers.fact: A misspelling that stuck — the real place is Marven Gardens.

answers.name: Electric Company
answers.fact: One of two utilities, where rent depends on your dice roll.

answers.name: Water Works
answers.fact: The other utility, and the least profitable square on the board.

answers.name: Illinois Avenue
answers.fact: Statistically the most landed-on property in the game.

answers.name: Pennsylvania Railroad
answers.fact: One of four railroads, each paying more as you collect the set.

answers.name: Oriental Avenue
answers.fact: The first of the light blue group after the first railroad.

answers.name: B&O Railroad
answers.fact: The Baltimore and Ohio, the oldest common carrier railroad in the country.

answers.name: Pennsylvania Avenue
answers.fact: Part of the green group, and the priciest set before the dark blues.

answers.name: Short Line
answers.fact: A railroad in the game, though the real Shore Fast Line was a streetcar.

answers.name: New York Avenue
answers.fact: Completes the orange set, the most landed-on group after leaving jail.

answers.name: St. Charles Place
answers.fact: Demolished in 1978 to make way for a casino.

answers.name: Connecticut Avenue
answers.fact: The last of the light blues.

answers.name: Atlantic Avenue
answers.fact: One of the yellows, and a real Atlantic City street.

answers.name: St. James Place
answers.fact: An orange property, and once the site of a famous nightclub.

answers.name: Pacific Avenue
answers.fact: The first green property after Free Parking.

answers.name: Tennessee Avenue
answers.fact: The middle orange, and one of the shrewdest buys in the game.

answers.name: Virginia Avenue
answers.fact: The last of the pink group.

answers.name: North Carolina Avenue
answers.fact: The middle green property.

answers.name: Kentucky Avenue
answers.fact: The first red property after Free Parking.

answers.name: Indiana Avenue
answers.fact: The middle red, easy to forget and easy to land on.

answers.name: Vermont Avenue
answers.fact: The middle light blue.

answers.name: Ventnor Avenue
answers.fact: The second yellow, named for a town next to Atlantic City.

answers.name: States Avenue
answers.fact: The middle pink, and the property most players cannot name.
